mapper.sql: P.PST_SN , P.MBR_SN , P.BBS_CD , P.PST_STTS_CD , P.PST_TTL , P.PST_CN , P.INQ_CNT , P.RCMDTN_CNT , P.REG_DT , P.MDFCN_DT , P.MDFR_ID , P.HLTH_INFO_EXPSR_SEQ

P.PST_SN , P.BBS_CD , P.PST_TTL , P.PST_CN , M.MBR_NCNM , P.REG_DT , (SELECT I.ATCH_FILE_SN FROM PST_IMG I WHERE I.PST_SN = P.PST_SN AND I.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY I.SORT_SEQ, I.PST_IMG_SN LIMIT 1) AS THUMB_ATCH_FILE_SN , P.RCMDTN_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMNT C WHERE C.PST_SN = P.PST_SN AND C.DEL_YN = 'N') AS CMNT_CNT , CASE WHEN P.PST_SN IN (SELECT B.PST_SN FROM (SELECT PST_SN FROM PST WHERE PST_STTS_CD = #{pstSttsCd} AND RCMDTN_CNT > 0 AND REG_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY RCMDTN_CNT DESC, REG_DT DESC, PST_SN DESC LIMIT 5) B) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS POPULAR
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM PST P JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = P.MBR_SN WHERE P.PST_STTS_CD = #{pstSttsCd}
AND P.BBS_CD = #{bbsCd}
AND (P.PST_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.PST_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN P.PST_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
P.RCMDTN_CNT DESC, P.REG_DT DESC, P.PST_SN DESC
P.REG_DT DESC, P.PST_SN DESC
SELECT FROM PST P JOIN MBR M ON M.MBR_SN = P.MBR_SN WHERE P.PST_STTS_CD = #{pstSttsCd} AND P.BBS_CD = #{bbsCd} AND P.HLTH_INFO_EXPSR_SEQ IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P.HLTH_INFO_EXPSR_SEQ, P.PST_SN LIMIT 3

SELECT FROM PST P WHERE P.PST_STTS_CD = #{pstSttsCd} AND P.BBS_CD = #{bbsCd} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PST_IMG I WHERE I.PST_SN = P.PST_SN AND I.DEL_YN = 'N')
AND P.REG_DT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
ORDER BY P.RCMDTN_CNT DESC, P.REG_DT DESC, P.PST_SN DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMNT WHERE PST_SN = #{pstSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT PST_IMG_SN , PST_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , SORT_SEQ , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID FROM PST_IMG WHERE PST_SN = #{pstSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ , PST_IMG_SN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PST ( MBR_SN , BBS_CD , PST_STTS_CD , PST_TTL , PST_CN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , MDFR_ID ) VALUES ( #{mbrSn} , #{bbsCd} , #{pstSttsCd} , #{pstTtl} , #{pstCn} , NOW() , NOW() , #{mdfrId} )

INSERT INTO PST_IMG ( PST_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , SORT_SEQ , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID ) VALUES ( #{pstSn} , #{atchFileSn} , #{sortSeq} , 'N' , NOW() , NOW() , #{rgtrId} , #{mdfrId} )
INSERT IGNORE INTO PST_INQ_HSTRY ( PST_SN , MBR_SN , INQ_YMD , REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{pstSn} , #{mbrSn} , CURDATE() , NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE PST SET INQ_CNT = INQ_CNT + 1 , MDFCN_DT = MDFCN_DT WHERE PST_SN = #{pstSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO PST_RCMDTN ( PST_SN , MBR_SN , USE_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( #{pstSn} , #{mbrSn} , 'Y' , NOW() , NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE PST SET RCMDTN_CNT = GREATEST(RCMDTN_CNT + #{delta}, 0) , MDFCN_DT = MDFCN_DT WHERE PST_SN = #{pstSn}
